references.text: The instruction to use a male goat as a sin offering for a leader, reflecting the established practice for sin offerings in the books of Moses.
The children of Israel were commanded to take a male goat as a sin offering, the same type of offering that the leaders brought.
A male goat is used as a sin offering for unintentional sins committed by the entire congregation.
At the new moon festival, a male goat was to be sacrificed as a sin offering to the Lord, the same type of offering as in the consecration.
A male goat as a sin offering for atonement, showing the repeated use of this sacrifice during festivals.
During Hezekiah's temple cleansing, male goats were sacrificed as sin offerings for the kingdom, the sanctuary, and Judah.
At the temple dedication after the exile, male goats were sacrificed as sin offerings for all Israel.
